lead: Ohio plumbing deals with old housing, basements, lead service lines and cold winters. PipeMend sends licensed local plumbers from Cleveland to Cincinnati.
risk: aging pipes and lead service lines, flooded basements and frozen pipes
risk_short: old pipes, flooded basements and frozen pipes
why: Ohio has a lot of older housing, with galvanized supply lines, cast-iron drains and lead service lines in Cleveland, Cincinnati, Toledo and Dayton.

Heavy rain floods basements and backs up sewers. Lake-effect snow and cold snaps freeze pipes. The Ohio Construction Industry Licensing Board licenses plumbing contractors for commercial work, and many cities license residential plumbers.
tips: Ask your utility about your service line.
Test your sump pump before spring.
areas: Calls come from Columbus, Cleveland, Cincinnati, Toledo, Akron, Dayton, Youngstown and rural Ohio.

faq.a: The Ohio Construction Industry Licensing Board licenses plumbing contractors for commercial work, and many cities license plumbers for residential work. Check with your local building department.
